page_title: FUL 1-4 WOL | Fulham v Wolves 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Here is a change. Nelson Semedo is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Alfie Pond (Wolves).
90+5' 1 - 4 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
90+2' Substitution. Rodrigo Gomes makes way for Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves).
90+2' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Matheus Cunha and he is replaced by Goncalo Guedes (Wolves).
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joao Gomes leaves the pitch and Thomas Doyle (Wolves) comes on.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
87' 1 - 3 Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top right corner in trademark fashion.
87' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde goes off the pitch and Matt Doherty (Wolves) comes on.
86' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Jose Sa was alert and made a comfortable save.
84' Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
81' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
79' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
77' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
77' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Matheus Cunha (Wolves), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
76' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jose Sa intercepts the ball.
71' Reiss Nelson will be replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).
71' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Raul Jimenez is replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
71' The substitution is prepared. Timothy Castagne (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kenny Tete.
71' Harry Wilson (Fulham) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
67' Kenny Tete (Fulham) is booked.
67' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
67' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
66' Robert Jones blows for a foul after Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
66' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
65' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
62' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
59' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Andreas Pereira will be replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
59' Substitution. Emile Smith Rowe will be replaced by Harry Wilson (Fulham).
59' Robert Jones has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kenny Tete (Fulham).
57' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Robert Jones ignores the protests.
57' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
57' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fulham.
56' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

53' 1 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Matheus Cunha, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Joao Gomes (Wolves), who beats Bernd Leno with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
52' The ball is cleared after Reiss Nelson (Fulham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
48' The game is interrupted. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' The foul by Calvin Bassey (Fulham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Robert Jones.
45+3' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
45+2' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Fulham will have a corner.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Jones no option but to blow his whistle.
41' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
40' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
37' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
36' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
36' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

34' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Robert Jones with no other option than to blow for a foul.
31' 1 - 1 Goal! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the roof of the net.
30' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
28' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) is flagged for offside.

25' Kenny Tete (Fulham) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
25' Poor challenge! Joao Gomes (Wolves) is penalised for tripping and Robert Jones blows his whistle.
23' A cross by Matheus Cunha (Wolves) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
23' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
20' 1 - 0 Goal! Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is teed up on the edge of the box by Kenny Tete, and his howitzer of a shot inside the left post gives the keeper no chance. 1:0.
19' Dangerous play by Joachim Andersen (Fulham). Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Robert Jones blows his whistle after Matheus Cunha (Wolves) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
18' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the crossbar to safety.
17' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
14' The resulting corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is cleared.
13' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) takes a short corner kick.
13' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
11' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
9' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
6' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Jones saw the whole situation.
5' A dangerous towering header by Raul Jimenez (Fulham) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
5' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
4' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fulham.
4' Andre (Wolves) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Robert Jones blows his whistle for an infringement.
2' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The first half has just begun.
Wolves will kick the game off.
Robert Jones will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
